Moody vibes in a great cocktail bar
Jul 2025 • Solo
This is a quaint cocktail bar with a real well inside hence the name. 
I was served by Nhi and she is an excellent cocktail waitress. I had the Pho cocktail and it actually tasted like the meal in a great alcoholic way. 
Nice card games available by the bar which I found hilarious. 
Great sound track which is always a tell for a great cocktail place. 
Only critique to make from my visit is the toilets. They are outside in the patio garden area and I found them a bit dirty on my visit so staff should be checking these more regularly.

reviews.review_text:
Stuart F
4 contributions
0
Like nothing you’ve experienced.
Mar 2024 • Solo
What a venue! Truly amazing ambiance and architecture. The staff are attentive and so very cool. Last night I witnessed true alchemy as the mixologist did his thing. 

Young Kiên was waiting on me and he was extremely professional with a good command of English and a very cool sense of humour. 

The range of drinks is outstanding. As others have mentioned in their reviews here, the pho cocktail is astonishing. I’m talking out of this world! 

Heading back there now to savour the whole box and dice before leaving for Hue in the morning. 

If you come to Hanoi and don’t check this bar out, you will never know what you’ve missed out on. Just do it.
